messages.content: For this planning task, keep these fixed inputs: the workshop has 7 benches, each bench seats 3 people, and 5 standing places must be added to any capacity count.
Noted as fixed inputs: benches = 7, seats per bench = 3, standing places to add = 5.
Correction: I miscounted earlier, there are actually 9 benches.
So how many people can be seated in total?
With 9 benches and 3 seats each, total seating is 9 × 3 = 27 people.
State the full capacity of the workshop as a single number. End your reply with the number alone on the last line.
